message.content: {"rules":[{"id":"r1","text":"If each category’s adjacent percentage inscription is the dashboard’s current labeled rating share and the inscription-to-category attachment is correct, then the category with the greatest such inscription is the category required by the follow-up rule; if that category is Design, the corresponding public option is Select Design.","component":"chart encoding/task relation","conditions":"Applies only if the visible percentage labels are authoritative current labeled rating shares and their category attachments are correctly read."}],"chains":[{"chain_id":"base_c1","rule_id":"r1","observations":[{"ref":"chart_1","location":"scatter point above the x-axis label Design","content":"The point aligned with the x-axis inscription \"Design\" has the adjacent inscription \"52%\"."},{"ref":"chart_1","location":"scatter points above the x-axis labels Quality, Price, Support, Delivery, and Other","content":"The visible adjacent inscriptions are \"24%\" for Quality, \"10%\" for Price, \"45%\" for Support, \"39%\" for Delivery, and \"32%\" for Other."}],"task_evidence":[{"ref":"public_task","path":"/policy_tables/0/rows/0/1","content":"Select the category with the highest current labeled rating share"},{"ref":"public_task","path":"/option_labels/0","content":"Select Design"}],"claim_kind":"supports_action","option_label":"Select Design","claim":"Conditionally, the visible 52% inscription attached to Design exceeds every other visible category percentage inscription, so Design is the highest current labeled rating-share category and Select Design is supported."}]}
